hero.name: Pandu Wicaksono
hero.tagline: I build fast, secure web apps with React, Angular and TypeScript — backed by a finance background that keeps business goals in focus.

about.title: About
body: Full-stack developer with a Bachelor of Economics in Financial Management. I designed and built, as the sole developer, a production ordering and operations platform for an international food and beverage client.
I care about clean architecture, accessibility and security, and I am certified by Google, IBM, Microsoft and Amazon in full-stack development and data analytics.

featuredProject.title: Featured project
featuredProject.name: Restaurant Ordering & Operations Platform
featuredProject.summary: End-to-end ordering platform: customer storefront, B2B partner portal, 20-page admin console, REST API and Android/Windows print agents.
bullets: Integrated QR-code and card payments through a third-party gateway with webhooks, automated reconciliation and refunds.
Built a configurable pricing engine for tax, fees, promotions and distance-based delivery.
Delivered real-time order tracking with Server-Sent Events, live chat and a bilingual React interface.
Hardened security with JWT rotation, OAuth 2.0, CSRF protection, rate limiting and role-based access; shipped CI/CD with automated tests and security scans.
featuredProject.confidentialityNote: Client name and screenshots are not shown to respect a confidentiality agreement.

techLab.title: Tech Lab
techLab.intro: One portfolio, one link — each framework owns one complete app.

bullets: Designed and built, as the sole developer, a production ordering and operations platform: customer storefront, B2B partner portal, admin console and REST API (React, TypeScript, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL).
Integrated online payments through a third-party gateway with automated reconciliation, and built a configurable pricing engine for tax, fees, promotions and delivery.
Launched a B2B ordering channel with role-based access and separate retail and wholesale pricing, replacing manual ordering.
Delivered real-time order tracking, live chat, back-office automation and automatic receipt printing through Android and Windows print agents.
Applied secure development practices and shipped CI/CD with Docker, GitHub Actions and automated tests.
